<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read the input data
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv')

# Pivot the data into a city-year by indicator matrix
df_pivoted = pd.pivot_table(df, values='value', index=['city_id', 'year'], columns='indicator_id', aggfunc='first')

# Reset the index to get the desired column order
df_pivoted = df_pivoted.reset_index()

# Reorder the columns to have city_id, city_name, year first, then the indicators
df_pivoted = df_pivoted[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + sorted(df_pivoted.columns.tolist()[3:])]

# Write the pivoted data to the output file
df_pivoted.to_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>
